patch.summary: Kit cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Kit pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. Free entry: Newsletter. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Kit plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

blocks.heading: Kit cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Kit against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Newsletter until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (email campaigns, newsletter builder, email templates) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
